channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history and views of Indian River waterways
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years and offers views of the Indian River.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse celebrates 165 years guiding ships along Atlantic coast
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, continues to draw visitors who climb its 105 steps for panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet and the Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff to reach Wimbledon final after dramatic tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday, becoming the fourth Czech woman in the last six years to reach the final.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names and logos ahead of inaugural season
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League announced the nicknames and logos of its four teams ahead of its debut season starting August 1, with each team name inspired by pioneering women.
